text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a training session with Inari
One...

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text:
I-incredible! It's like Inari's tearing up
the track as
she goes!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I've gone and got a li'l messy. But
hey,
these dirt stains are a badge of
honor!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sure. I've been confident in my strength
since long before I even came here.
Doesn't mean I
shouldn't keep aimin'
higher, though!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is the biggest stage, with the
flashiest
fireworks, after all. Havin' a li'l
extra firepower
can't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That said, today felt real good. Guess
it's 'bout
time to wrap up, eh?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um... Inari! If it's okay with you,
would you
go partner running with us?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text:
We want to learn from your running
style!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: H-hold up! Give an Uma some space!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Geez, ya talk like it's got nothin' to do
with ya.
Guess I shouldn't complain 'bout
bein' popular
though.
choice_data_list: I can understand wanting to crowd ...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Wouldn't have the attention at all
if it
weren't
for a certain someone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, all righty then! I'm up for
another lap or
two!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, put more back into it! If ya
wanna get
your engines revvin', ya gotta
step on the gas!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Inari One continues to offer the
younger
Umamusume her powerful
advice.
